title: Agents can now find Vercel CLI commands by describing the task
summary_en: Coding agents can now use vercel help search to find Vercel CLI commands by describing a task in plain language. The search returns a list of matching commands. Add --with-help to include the help page for the first result in the same call. For example, vercel help search "roll back production" --with-help returns the options and examples for vercel rollback . Search also supports: API endpoints: When a Vercel API endpoint matches the task, search returns a vercel api command with the request path and placeholders for every required input. The agent can fill in the values without guessing…
